planets.name: TOI-201 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-201 with a 53-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-201 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-201. Its orbit and size follow Mireles et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
